channel.title: Ghostex Updates
channel.description: Sparkle appcast for Ghostex macOS releases.

item.description:
# Ghostex 11.7.1
## 11.7.1 - 2026-11-15
**Ghostex 11.7.1 is out.** Sessions no longer wake up and spend your usage on their own after a usage limit or a restart, long chats are compacted before they carry on, workers under a coordinator stop sending you notifications, the project picker and the browser bar show each computer's own logo, sidebar extensions arrive, and Settings search finds only real matches.
### 🔋 Usage after a limit or a restart
- **Sessions stay put after a usage limit:** with Switch accounts and no saved account, a session at its limit stays stopped and nothing is typed into it. After a restart, a limit wait asks "Continue after the limit reset?" with Continue and Not now, and while it waits a card shows the time and a Stop button. A message Ghostex sends by itself now says so (#608). - **Threads stopped by a restart wait for you:** a coordinator's threads that were cut off when Ghostex closed show a red dot ("Stopped when Ghostex closed"), and the coordinator shows one card with Carry on and Not now. Turn on Resume sessions after a restart to let them carry on by themselves (#608). - **Compact first, save usage:** the Continue and Carry on cards have a Compact first box, ticked for chats above the size in Settings > Agents > Claude Code > Compact chats above (200K by default), so a long chat is summarised before it re-reads everything after a break. Claude, Codex, Grok and Cursor. - **Workers are compacted before their coordinator returns:** when a coordinator messages a thread whose prompt cache has expired and whose chat is above that size, Ghostex compacts it first, then delivers the message. Turn it off with Compact workers before a coordinator returns to them.
### 🧭 Coordinators
- **Workers stop notifying you:** a coordinator's thread that finishes, asks a question, gets stuck or ends on an error tells its coordinator instead of you, and only shows its red or pink dot. Approvals and blocked accounts still reach you, and a worker's approval opens on the coordinator. Settings > Notifications > Workers (Off, Silent or Sound) brings them back. On the computer and the phone. - **A clearer Workers popover:** running work and threads that need you come first, finished ones fold into one line, and each row shows the agent's logo, a two-line preview and its work item. - **Threads named in the chat look calmer:** a thread's name is text with a faint dotted underline, no frame, with a dot only while it works or needs you, in messages, on Message from and to cards and in the chat box. Clicking a name for another computer's session opens it there.
### 🖥️ Computers
- **Each computer wears its own logo:** pick Apple, Windows, Tux, Ubuntu, Debian, Fedora, Arch or Red Hat as a computer's icon, or let it show its own system's logo; every computer you connect sees the same icon. - **A new project picker:** each project is one line with its own icon (or its letter on a coloured tile), and its computers sit in columns as their logos, with a computer that isn't connected shown faint. The browser's address bar also shows only the logo of the computer a page loads from, with its name on hover. - **Remote connections when two computers share an id:** Ghostex now tells this computer apart from a remote that happens to share its short server id, and says why agents can't reach it, thanks to @banozz0.
### 🧩 Extensions
- **Sidebar extensions:** an extension can add its own mode beside Bots, sections above or below the projects, a side panel and its own pages, and can ship an agent skill you choose to install with it. - **The Store shows more before you install:** each extension's real icon, README and changelog, and a GitHub link for community extensions. Store pages load faster.
### 🐧 Linux and Windows
- **Omarchy and Hyprland:** dragging a Ghostex window follows the pointer without black flashes, Ghostex's own windows can be moved by their top strip, and double-clicking it maximizes and restores the window. - **Copy and paste in text boxes on Linux** with Ctrl+Shift+C and Ctrl+Shift+V, so Superwhisper and Omarchy's Super+C and Super+V reach the chat box. - **Windows finds your editors for Open In:** Zed, VS Code, VS Code Insiders, VSCodium, Cursor, Trae, Kiro, Antigravity and JetBrains IDEs installed on Windows now show up and open.
### 🩹 Fixes and polish
- **Terminals open when macOS blocks a copied helper:** source builds that macOS won't let run from Ghostex's session folder fall back to the app's own copy instead of hanging (#619), thanks to @banozz0. - **Settings search finds only real matches:** searching "spaces" no longer lists every page with "workspaces" or "Monospace" in it. On the computer and the phone. - **Annotate in Files** keeps its buttons in the file's header instead of a floating toolbar. - **A new session shows in the sidebar:** opening a session unfolds its collapsed section, group and project so its row is visible. - **The phone's tab swipe** holds when your finger drifts down, and hovering a pinned coordinator shows the same buttons as any other row.

# Ghostex 11.7.0
## 11.7.0 - 2026-11-14
**Ghostex 11.7.0 is out.** Agents can restyle Ghostex with sixteen new theme colours, a memory guard that stops a runaway command before the computer stalls, Claude Code's idle compaction and the 1-hour cache in Settings, settings you can export and import, a clearer Autopilot page, project folders you trust by choice, Easy Connect between two computers (also from the phone), the Beads view on the phone, Ghostex on Omarchy and Hyprland, and Superwhisper dictation on Linux.
### 🎨 Themes
- **Ask an agent to restyle Ghostex:** any agent can change the look with `ghostex theme`: the Interface settings and sixteen new theme colours (borders, dividers, text, grey text, the accent, cards, controls, menus, rows, your messages, the chat box and the status colours), each set apart for dark and light mode, so "the borders are too bright" is one command. The agent's chat shows a Theme changed card with Undo and says when a change makes something hard to read; `ghostex theme undo`, `redo` and `history` keep the last 20 changes. - **Theme colours in Settings:** Settings > Interface > Theme colours lists the sixteen colours for dark and light mode, with Reset on each and a warning when a colour is hard to read.
### 🧠 Memory guard
- **A memory guard, on by default:** when the computer has been critically short of memory for 10 seconds, Ghostex stops the heaviest command an agent session started (or reloads the agent when it is the heavy part), and stops the whole session if memory is still critical 30 seconds later. That chat shows a card saying what was stopped and you get a notification. Turn it off in Settings > Power & Sleep > Memory. On macOS and Linux. - **A session the guard stopped shows a red dot** until it runs again, and opens to the guard's card. The guard's switches apply to every computer you use, and the phone reads and changes them in Settings > Connection > Memory.
### 🤖 Agents
- **Claude Code's idle compaction in Settings:** expand Claude Code in Settings > Agents to turn off compacting idle chats before the prompt cache expires, set the smallest chat it compacts (100K to 500K), or ask for the 1-hour prompt cache on an API key, Bedrock, Vertex or Foundry. Session details' Cache card shows the cache length and when an idle chat will be compacted. The phone has the same settings in Settings > Chat > Claude Code. - **Compact an idle Codex chat before you send:** when a Codex chat's last turn is more than a day old, the chat box shows "Option + Enter to compact then send" ("Alt + Enter" on Windows and Linux), so the next message doesn't re-read the whole conversation uncached. The hint goes once a new turn starts. - **You choose which project folders agents trust:** project folders are no longer trusted for agents automatically. When an agent asks whether to trust its folder, the chat shows a Trust this folder? card naming the agent and the folder, with Trust folder (Cmd+Enter) and Don't trust (Esc). To trust every project folder again, turn on Settings > Agents > Trust project folders automatically in that computer's own Settings, which asks for Touch ID, Windows Hello or your password. On the computer, in the browser and on the phone. - **Restart in Bypass when idle:** the Mode menu's greyed Bypass row has a switch that waits until Claude is idle, restarts it on the same conversation in Bypass, and keeps that chat starting in Bypass. Turning it off before then cancels it. - **The chat asks before turning an agent's hooks back on:** a Claude, Codex or OpenCode session Ghostex can't follow for 90 seconds now shows a "Turn on Claude's hooks?" card instead of installing the hook by itself, and Use agent hooks moved to Settings > Debugging. - **Codex keeps other tools' hooks trusted** when Ghostex moves its own Codex hooks, and a Codex sitting on a sign-in screen or a dialog no longer looks like a Codex Ghostex can't follow (#604, #610), thanks to @sebastianarena.
### 🛡️ Autopilot
- **A clearer Autopilot page:** pick Off, Careful or Full at the top (Custom when you mix your own), then one row each for questions (Wait for me, or answer after 5, 10 or 15 minutes) and permission (Wait for me, Safe steps, or All but limits). Approval cards now wait a minute for you before Autopilot answers them, hard limits show and count only with All but limits, Every session lists the projects and sessions you left out, and the supervisor and the sweep moved under Advanced. On the computer and the Android app.
### ⚙️ Settings
- **Export and import settings:** Settings > Sync can save your settings to a JSON file and apply it on another computer, showing how many settings change before it saves them. Secrets, sign-ins and settings of one computer (folders, the glass picture, scale and zoom) stay out. Also `ghostex settings export` and `ghostex settings import`. - **Settings show only what applies:** a row that only matters while its parent switch is on is hidden while that switch is off, and a turned-off agent's panel keeps only its switch, its command line group, Duplicate and Delete. On the computer, in the browser and on the phone. - **A friendlier first run:** Welcome says Ghostex is the workspace around 20+ coding agents, its Coordinators tab plays a short demo, each agent row says how Ghostex follows it and the button names the agent it connects, and the devices page shows how your phone, other computers and Cloud Boxes connect. - **Star Ghostex on GitHub:** after a few messages a small sidebar card asks for a GitHub star (Dismiss ends it), and Settings > About has a Star on GitHub row.
### 💬 Chat
- **Mentioned sessions are rich pills:** a session you mention shows in the chat box and the sent message with its agent's logo, title, a state dot and its computer's icon, and hovering it shows the session's card. Message cards and the Workers popover name sessions the same way. On the computer and the phone. - **Quiet View shows a turn's time once:** an opened line's card is titled by its calls ("3 tool calls"), a line with several turns marks where each turn starts ("Then · 22s"), and a lone tool call gets its own card. On the computer and the phone. - **The chat follows the end again** after a small scroll up or a scrollbar drag, as on the phone ([#615](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/615)), thanks to @sebastianarena for raising it. - **The usage bar holds steady:** it no longer flips between different sessions' readings, and the 7-day reset row stays (#614), thanks to @sebastianarena. - **Up moves the caret in typed text:** Up recalls sent messages only when the chat box is empty or shows an unedited recalled message. - **The Context card in Session details folds again,** starts folded with its usage and Compact context showing, and remembers your choice. - **The selection bar and a command's Copy bar match the chat's menus** instead of a dark tooltip bubble.
### 🧭 Coordinators
- **An ask in the coordinator dock opens in a floating panel** over the chat, like a Ghostex page, with its description, answers, Reply and the ⋯ menu. It closes by itself with an Answered or Withdrawn toast when the ask is settled elsewhere. On the phone it opens in a sheet. - **Quiet while threads work:** a coordinator's turn that ends while its threads are still working no longer shows a dot or sends a notification; the turn that ends with none working does. - **A coordinator's threads stay under it:** a done thread kept open is no longer moved to Parked, Clean up in the Work panel no longer parks threads, and threads parked this way by earlier versions move back under their coordinator. A thread you park yourself stays parked. - **Commands in an ask get Run in terminal,** as they do in the chat. On the computer and the phone.
### 🌐 Remote computers and Easy Connect
- **Connect two computers in one window:** Connect a Computer shows this computer's code with a box for the other's, one progress list, and Connect both ways when it's done. A computer paired with Easy Connect signs in with its own key, and Connect a Phone and Connect a Computer are separate items in the sidebar menu and Settings > Remote. - **Connect two computers from the phone:** a paired phone can link two of its computers to each other both ways. - **Easy Connect only when you ask for it:** nothing is added to Easy Connect while it is off, and the phone asks once whether a Tailscale computer may fall back to Easy Connect, with a Fall back to Easy Connect switch on each computer's page (#605, [#603](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/603)), thanks to @sebastianarena. - **A remote project's browser opens public sites from this computer** and sends only that computer's own and private addresses through it; the route chip says which. - **Easy Connect is fast on Linux:** a link that goes over a Tailscale path no longer crawls at a few KB/s and drops. - **Signing in to a Linux computer with its saved password no longer needs netcat,** so Easy Connect from Omarchy or Arch works without installing it. - **Open pages keep working after a connection to another computer is rebuilt.** - **Windows computers stay reachable:** commands sent to a Windows computer are no longer blocked by Windows Defender, and a terminal that fails to attach stops after 6 tries and says why. ([#613](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/613))
### 🐧 Linux
- **Ghostex fits Omarchy and Hyprland:** menus, the model and Mode menus, More actions, toasts, onboarding and dialogs open in place at their own size instead of as large floating windows, pages open at their window's size, sidebar submenus open beside their menu, and a page's ⋯ menu and Snooze work. - **Glass follows the desktop:** the window turns solid when the desktop won't blur, and glass comes back with Omarchy's Glassy Windows. - **Superwhisper dictation on Linux:** Settings > Dictation offers Superwhisper where it's installed, with its own language, tone and vocabulary, and puts the text in the chat box (phone dictations too). A new install with Superwhisper starts on it.
### 📱 On the phone
- **The Beads view on the phone:** a Beads row beside Changes opens the Tree with filters, Show done, the sync pill with Pull and Push, and each bead full screen with its links, also for computers reached over SSH (#606), thanks to @sebastianarena. - **A stuck iPhone connection is replaced in seconds** instead of being kept for a minute or more, and the computer stops waiting on a request that stopped arriving (#612, ghostex-mobile #43), thanks to @sebastianarena. - **Logs export as a file** with the details that explain a dropped connection (#607), thanks to @sebastianarena. - **The first screen offers Scan the code and Use Tailscale side by side,** and the demo is called the demo experience.
### 🩹 Fixes and polish
- **Sessions open through an app update keep access to Documents, Desktop and Downloads** on a Mac, and a terminal that already lost it after an update offers Restart. ([#611](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/611)) - **HTML pages in Files and Docs open in their own isolated view,** and a ghostex:// link asks before adding a new project. - **The Files view always shows its file list** when no file is open, and a list that fails to load says so with Retry. - **A snoozed page stays hidden until its time.** - **Dialogs in the browser have the app's rounded corners,** so the Rename dialog no longer looks cut off across the chat (#602), thanks to @sebastianarena for raising it.

# Ghostex 11.6.1
## 11.6.1 - 2026-11-13
**Ghostex 11.6.1 is out.** Codex on Windows recovers when it quits, model lists read live from each agent, a coordinator on any agent with a clearer setup, fewer coordinator notifications, a limit card that can continue on Opus, folded sent answers, and many fixes, on the computer and the Android app.
### 🤖 Agents and models
- **Codex recovers when it quits early:** a Codex that quits before its first message shows "Codex isn't running" with Restart, and a message you send then restarts it and goes through. ([#595](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/595)) - **Model lists come from each agent:** the model menu for Claude Code, Cursor and Antigravity now matches what the agent itself offers, read from its own model picker, with older versions under Legacy models (GPT-5.6 Terra, Opus 5 and Sonnet 5 are back there), and Antigravity lists Gemini 4 Carbon. - **Amp picks its model in Amp:** Amp's model pill says "Pick the model in Amp" and opens Terminal view. - **Gemini CLI is no longer supported:** it leaves Settings > Agents, the New session menu, setup and the Agents Hub. Antigravity CLI runs Google's Gemini models.
### 🔐 Accounts and limits
- **The limit card says why it didn't switch and can continue on Opus:** when no account has room, the card names the model ("No account has room for Fable 5.2"), says in one sentence why each other account is out and when it continues, and offers to continue on another model with room ("Continue with Opus 5.5 on ST"). A Fable session that runs out on every account continues on Opus by itself; turn that off with Settings > Accounts > Claude rules > Continue on Opus when Fable runs out. On the computer and the phone. - **Usage shows right after a reset is used:** the usage popup, sidebar meters and Settings > Accounts show a Claude account's new limits at once, and clicking "Updated … ago" in a Claude or Codex usage popup reads that account again (Refresh now).
### 🧭 Coordinators
- **Pick a coordinator's agent after the form:** New Coordinator no longer asks for agent, model and effort; Next opens the agent picker, "Pick the coordinator's agent", with every agent you have, on the computer and the phone. Any agent can now run a coordinator. - **A coordinator on a weaker setup says so:** a coordinator on a model or effort that may make it work worse shows an amber "Coordinator quality may be degraded" pill with why and Hide for this chat, and tells you once. A coordinator that drifts from its playbook is reminded in its next message. - **Coordinators notify you only for what needs you:** a coordinator finishing a turn no longer notifies; only a turn that adds a question, a Needs you item or a Blocked item does. - **Codex's own reviewer is no longer an approval for you:** an approval Codex's reviewer decides no longer shows as your approval card, and the Approvals pill is red while a thread's approval waits on you. ([#597](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/597)) - **Workers shows each thread's work items:** a second line of item pills (two, then +N), with a hover card for the item's status, steps and asks and the thread's last report; a click shows the item in the Work panel. - **Idle threads are left alone:** a thread that ended its turn with a background shell still running counts as idle, so it no longer gets "no new output" nudges or stall reports. - **The How to use note reads in two short lines** under its pill.
### 💬 Chat
- **Your sent answers fold to one line:** the page's or form's name, "3 answered · 1 skipped" and a button that opens the page again; opened, each question shows once by its tag with its answer and note. On the computer and the phone. - **Select text to reply:** selecting text in the conversation shows a small bar with Copy, Add to Chat and Reply. - **Up recalls your sent messages:** Up in the chat box steps back through this chat's sent messages like a shell history, and never fails with "The agent already took this message". - **Pictures and files move with a paste across computers:** a picture or file pill pasted into a chat on another computer gets its file copied there, so the agent can open it. - **A "could not deliver" notice reaches a busy agent** as soon as its input box is ready, instead of waiting for a turn end that may never come. - **The ? pill no longer opens an empty popup** for a question a work item also asks.
### 🛡️ Autopilot
- **Autopilot answers approval cards by default:** Answer approval cards is on when Autopilot is on (a choice you made stays), and Autopilot never approves anything for a read-only thread.
### 🩹 Fixes and polish
- **Drag another computer's sessions in the sidebar** between Pinned, Sessions and Parked, and reorder them among the pinned ones. - **Popovers open at their full height** and fade in, instead of opening small and growing. - **Every drag shows the same see-through ghost** as a dragged sidebar session. - **Settings is quieter:** section subtitles that repeated what the switches say are cut or shortened. - **The Grok logo is as large as Claude's** in the chat header, sidebar, pickers and Settings. - **A tool call card opened inside a Quiet View card fills its width,** without the line beside its rows. On the computer and the phone. - **The Beads view's Tree and Board read the same project,** a narrow panel fits a new bead, the search and links, the divider width is kept, links show whole on hover, and failed syncs are logged (#599), thanks to @sebastianarena. - **An iPhone keeps a busy computer's connection** instead of reconnecting about every minute, a busy computer says what Reset connection does, and the phone's kept logs scrub names as they are written (#596, ghostex-mobile #39), thanks to @sebastianarena.

# Ghostex 11.6.0
## 11.6.0 - 2026-11-13
**Ghostex 11.6.0 is out.** Quiet View for every chat and a new Summary view, Session details in Overview and Limits tabs, Ghostex pages you can export and answer anywhere, Snooze for pages and forms, a voice agent that waits for "reply", calmer dictation that opens Hex by itself, accounts of your other computers managed from here, agents that run without Ghostex's hooks, read-only threads for coordinators, long messages that always arrive, Claude on Windows PowerShell 5.1, and a lighter phone app.
### 👁️ Chat views
- **Quiet View is on for every chat:** every chat now reads as the conversation, with the work between two replies folded into one line, and the newest turn opens by itself. An opened line's header says what it holds ("Working", "Worked for 2m 5s", "Previous turn") instead of its counts. Settings > Chat > Advanced still turns it off. On the computer and the phone. - **Summary view shows your messages and the newest reply:** earlier replies and reports sit behind one "N earlier replies · N reports" line, only pages, charts and questions still waiting on you stay in full, and work that comes after a reply in the same turn (a thread's report, a background task) shows under Active work instead of hiding until the turn ends. On the computer and the phone. - **Detailed view is Quiet View with every line open,** so switching views only opens or shuts lines and nothing jumps. - **Agent work Reduced and Quiet, and the Tool call cards preview, are retired:** Quiet View replaces them, and anyone who used one of them starts in Quiet View.
### 📄 Pages and forms
- **Export a Ghostex page and get its answers back:** any page downloads as one HTML file that works in any browser, where its Send becomes Export answers (JSON to copy or download). Drop or paste that JSON into a chat, or use Import answers, and it reaches the agent as the page's own answers. On the computer and the phone. - **Snooze for pages and forms:** a form card and the page window get Snooze, with 1 hour, 6 hours and 24 hours, which puts the form off For later until then. On the computer and the phone. - **The page window has a ⋯ menu:** Snooze, Export page, Import answers and Open in browser sit under one ⋯ beside Hide and Close, in a light glass that reads over the page. - **Popups stay open when you switch apps:** Settings, the page window and the chat's form popup no longer close when you go to another app, so you can paste from a clipboard app. - **A form popup fades out once its answers are sent,** and stays open on them when the send fails; the page window fades out the same way. - **Reply and Mention for forms and pages in the work list:** a form's or page's row has Reply beside Open, whose words go to the agent tagged with the questions it still asks, and Mention in chat box in its ⋯ menu. A question form's row is marked with a pink checklist. On the computer and the phone. - **Copy as Markdown from the work list:** a row's ⋯ menu (now also on a right-click of its title) copies a question with its details and answers, or a form with each question, as Markdown. - **A Ghostex page no longer shrinks for a moment after it opens:** about a second after an answered or new page opened, it was drawn at about two thirds of its size in the window's corner and then grew back.
### 🧾 Session details
- **Session details has Overview and Limits tabs:** Overview holds Environment (with the agent's version), Changes, Context with Compact context under it, Tasks, Connectors, Skills, Memory files, Background tasks and the agent's other settings; Limits holds your plan limits with their reset times, Cost and time, and Cache. On the computer, in the browser and on the phone. - **The Context card shows its usage when folded:** it opens folded with its usage line and bar under its title, and unfolds for the breakdown; a card with nothing more to show has no fold. - **The status line under the phone's chat box follows the computer:** it shows the pins you saved for each agent in the Ghostex app on the chat's computer, and Context details says so.
### 🎙️ Voice and dictation
- **The voice agent waits until you say "reply":** with Settings > Voice Agent > Answer when I say "reply" (on by default for Regular calls), the agent answers a spoken turn only once it ends with "reply", "over" or "go ahead", so a pause to think no longer gets an answer. On the computer and the phone. - **Dictation opens Hex by itself:** on a Mac, dictating while Hex is closed opens it in the background and transcribes once it is ready, instead of failing. - **A live waveform while you dictate:** the recording pill shows your voice as it records, with ✕ to cancel on the left (the microphone's Stop finishes), and says "Can't hear you" after 3 seconds of near-silence. While dictation can't transcribe yet, the microphone is greyed and says why. On the computer and the phone. - **Calm dictation cards:** a problem shows in a small Dictate card that says what to do, and your recording is always safe in Past recordings. A refused microphone, no words heard and nothing waiting are cards too, not toasts. On the computer and the phone. - **Dictated words go where you were typing:** they replace the selection, or go in at the caret, that the chat box or question form box had when you started recording, even if you clicked elsewhere meanwhile. On the computer and the phone.
### 🔐 Accounts and privacy
- **Manage another computer's accounts from here:** Settings > Accounts has a computer picker that shows a connected computer's saved Claude and Codex accounts and usage. Adding or reconnecting one signs in on that computer while the sign-in page opens on yours, and a remote session's Reconnect opens Accounts on its computer. On the computer and the phone. - **A Claude login waiting to renew stays ready:** it no longer says "The saved login expired. Reconnect this account." while its access token is only due for renewal. - **Turn usage analytics off with a launch option:** start Ghostex or its server with `--no-analytics`, or set `GHOSTEX_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1` or `DO_NOT_TRACK=1`, and no usage analytics are sent; setup no longer points to a Settings switch that did not exist, thanks to @lardissone for raising it. - **Reset all settings asks first:** one click on Reset all settings to defaults in Settings > About no longer puts every setting and the app icon back with no way back, and a key typed while a Settings confirmation is open stays in it (#589), thanks to @lardissone.
### 🤖 Agents
- **Claude, Codex and OpenCode run without Ghostex's hooks:** Ghostex follows them from their own files on every computer and removes only the hooks it had installed. If an agent goes unseen for 90 seconds, Ghostex installs its hook for that session and says so in the chat; Settings > Agents > Use agent hooks brings the hooks back for good. Without hooks, a Claude question with several questions shows them all in the chat card. - **Agents install the way their makers say:** first-run setup, Settings > Agents and Install buttons use each agent's official installer (its own install script, PowerShell on Windows, or npm, Homebrew or WinGet where that is how it ships) instead of mise, unless mise already manages it. DeepSeek Harness installs with npm, Pi with its own installer, Claude Code on Windows without Git for Windows, and OpenCode's Homebrew choice installs OpenCode 2. - **Antigravity's Update says it updates itself,** in Settings > Agents and the Updates list, instead of running an installer that does nothing.
### 🧭 Coordinators
- **Read-only threads:** `ghostex coordinator start-thread --read-only` starts a thread that can look but not change anything (Claude in Plan mode, Codex in its read-only sandbox), and it stays read-only across restarts and wakes. ([#554](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/554)) - **Coordinators read their playbook once:** the playbook ships in Ghostex, and `ghostex coordinator guide --changes` shows a coordinator only what changed since it last read it (#580), thanks to @lardissone. - **Playbook overrides have room to grow:** an override can be up to 100,000 characters (was 20,000), and past 20,000 every save says how long it is. ([#584](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/584)) - **The work list reads evenly and moves smoothly:** every text in it is one size, an opened row eases open and shut, scrolls just enough to show its answers when the list is full, and shows its threads as their agents' logos beside the answers. - **Coordinators mark their replies again by default:** Marked handovers is now one setting with three choices, Off, Coordinators only (the default) and Every session, so coordinators answer in marked sections without you changing anything; threads always mark their reports. Anyone who had it on for every session keeps Every session.
### 💬 Chat
- **Long messages always arrive:** a message over 256 KB (a pasted crash report, for example) now reaches the agent in pieces instead of failing with "The agent's terminal didn't take your message". - **A held message no longer holds up the queue:** a message Ghostex held for a moment goes out as soon as a working agent's input box is ready, instead of waiting for its whole turn. ([#591](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/591)) - **Leaving a session keeps its draft:** a draft another client wrote (for example with `ghostex set-session-chat-draft`) is no longer wiped when you leave the session. ([#587](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/587)) - **Drop a session on the chat box to link it:** dragging a session row from the sidebar onto a chat box types its link at the caret, as Copy ID copies it, instead of splitting the pane. - **A tidier More actions menu:** the chat box's More actions lists the everyday actions first, then Agent (Rename, Sleep, Fork Session, Switch Account and more) and More. On the computer and the phone. - **A pasted picture whose path has spaces shows as a picture,** on the computer and the phone. - **Legacy models open under their row:** in the model picker, opening Legacy models lists them below it with no gap. On the computer and the phone. - **A message that could not be sent says so calmly:** a failed or waiting message gets a small card right under it with its icon, "Not sent" (or "Waiting to send", "Still not sent"), the reason in one sentence, and Retry and Terminal view as buttons, with Fix it, Start fresh, Edit and Remove in its ⋯ menu. Every notice card in the chat is calmer too, with only its icon in colour. On the computer and the phone.

On the computer and the web. - **Tips on new chats, in place of Tips & Tricks:** a new chat shows a small card of tips under "What should we build with …?", one at a time with Previous, Next and Got it; Settings > Chat > Tips on new chats turns it off, and Show tips again brings back the ones you marked. The Tips & Tricks panel is gone. - **Compact context compacts again** (#572): Compact context in the context window panel sends `/compact` to the agent, the same as typing it, and says why in the chat box when it can't run, thanks to @KhalidSaifullahFuad for the report. - **Find starts at the newest match,** nearest the bottom of the chat, and goes up to older ones (loading older messages when needed). - **A message queued behind an agent that was killed goes out:** once the agent is confirmed gone, its turn, approval or question card no longer holds the queue, and sending starts it again (#555); an agent killed without a Stop hook no longer shows as working, thanks to @sebastianarena. - **A message that reaches the agent mid-turn no longer cuts the turn,** so its "Worked for" row holds all of the turn's work. - **A prompt hook that blocks a message says so** in the chat instead of nothing happening (#543). - **A running tool call shows its time so far,** and its card's total counts up with it. - **Every waiting question is drawn in the questions pink** (its badge, card, Q-tag chips and highlight), on the computer and the phone. - **The new chat's base branch list has a search,** with the picked branch first and the default branch next. - **Panels above the chat box keep their bottom edge:** the Links list, Switch Account and the context ring panel stay against their pill when their content grows or shrinks, instead of drifting up. - **Copy image works on Windows:** a copied picture pastes into Paint and other Windows apps, every picture is copied as PNG on every computer, and a copy that did not reach the clipboard says so. - **Long coordinator chats answer quickly again:** an event no longer rebuilds the whole Work panel, sessions that share a title no longer make every open chat rebuild its transcript when the sidebar reorders, and what you do in a chat goes ahead of the updates waiting for it. - **Codex no longer says "Message not sent" for a message it took while starting,** and Retry on a failed message first checks whether the agent already has it, so nothing is typed twice. - **A false "Usage limit reached" card no longer shows** when a session's tool output or a message only quotes Claude Code's limit dialog, and it no longer holds that session's queued messages.
### 📄 Ghostex pages
- **A page hides instead of closing:** a click outside it, its Hide button, a link that opens in the app's browser or another page puts it aside, still running, behind a tab you click to bring it back. - **A page with nothing to answer waits until you mark it seen:** it ends with a "Reply about this page" box and Mark as seen, sits in the list above the chat box as "Page, not seen yet" until you press it, and tells the agent you saw it, with your reply. - **A page with questions counts your answers** in a small pill at its bottom right ("3 of 10 answered"), green once all are answered. On the computer and the phone. - **A picture pasted into a page's note shows as an Image #1 pill** where you pasted it, as in the chat box, instead of Markdown text. - **A link clicked in a page opens where chat links open,** so Open links in embedded browser sends it to the app's Browser. - **Page answers send from an iPhone** (#566), thanks to @suatkocar.
### 🔗 Connect a Device and your computers
- **Connect a Device is one window:** the sidebar menu's Connect a phone is now Connect a Device, and its window lists three ways at its left (Phone, Computer and Tailscale). The code is small until you click it to scan, Copy the code sits under it, Tailscale shows its checklist with a button to Settings, and Remote at the bottom left opens Settings > Remote. - **Easy Connect installs its helper when it is missing** (#559): Connect a Device and Settings > Remote say the helper isn't installed yet, with Install, each step of the install and Try again, the code appears in the same window when it is done, and Settings > Updates lists the helper with Update. - **Pairing a phone again no longer leaves a second, dead entry for the same computer:** the phone recognises the computer and merges the older entry, and an Easy Connect key belongs to one device only, so a pairing can never take over another device's key (a refusal names the device that holds it). - **An Easy Connect computer that went silent is reachable again in about 20 seconds** (#526): when the path to its relay stops carrying without closing, the computer notices and starts the helper again. - **Connections come back faster and drop less:** a computer that was away is looked for every 15 seconds for its first ten minutes, a wake gets a second check before a connection is dropped, a phone registering its own key no longer stalls for six seconds, and a keychain prompt can no longer hold a computer on "Connecting". - **A dropping connection no longer shows "gxserver returned invalid JSON.":** an answer the link cut off is asked again on a fresh connection, and when it still can't arrive it says so in plain words, without sending a change twice. - **On Windows, Easy Connect's helpers stop when Ghostex does,** as they already did on macOS and Linux. - **File links in a chat of a session on another computer open in Files,** text and pictures, inside or outside the project, on Mac, Linux and Windows computers; a link to a network share doesn't open, and a link that can't open says why.

With the new Android app.
### 🎙️ Voice and Dictate
- **Dictate types into the question form box you are writing in,** from the hotkey or the microphone button, on the computer and the phone, thanks to @suatkocar. - **Type to the voice agent on the computer:** a text box under the voice panel's captions sends your words as your turn (Enter sends, Shift+Enter starts a new line), and the captions can be selected and copied. - **Mute the agent's voice for a call:** the voice panel's speaker button keeps the captions coming without the voice, next to the microphone's own mute. - **Changing the call mode switches a running call at once,** both ways, on the computer and the phone. - **The voice agent finds what you name loosely,** as a project or as a session or coordinator title, and speech that starts while a reply is still being made cancels it. - **Dictation says what really went wrong:** a refused xAI key says the key was refused, and a recording cut off on the way says it didn't arrive whole (and the phone sends it again).
